# **Ruffnauts: New Frontiers Open Beta is Here!**

**HATCH. RIDE. GO WILD.**

Ruffnauts is a FREE multiplayer creature collection game where you explore wild planets, discover crazy creatures, and battle giant bosses with your friends. Can you hatch them all?

Collect pets from capybaras to dragons, feed them tacos, and evolve them into companions you can ride! Gear up, bring your friends aboard, and explore new worlds in this creature-collecting VR adventure. 

# **🐾 Hatch, Feed, & Evolve**

Discover **150+ unique pets and variants**, from adorable capybaras to mighty dragons. Battle wild pets to collect eggs, care for your babies, and evolve them to ride.

[media]

# **⚡ Your Pets Are Your Ride**

Saddle up and feel the speed! Choose from **Speedsters, Tanks, and Gliders**, each with a different riding style to master. Tear across the ground or take your adventure to the sky.

[media]

# **🔧 Upgrade Your Pet**
Upgrade your pets with **weapons, attachments, and passenger saddles**. Equip them for battle or make room for friends to ride along.

[media]

# **🤝 Bring Your Crew**
Join **10 player lobbies** to battle huge bosses, collect eggs, and explore new wild worlds with your crew! Don't forget to style your cosmetics for a unique look!

[media]

# **🌀 Weekly Updates**
The adventure keeps growing with **weekly updates**. Jump into the Open Beta and shape what comes next.

**Your pet. Your crew. Your next frontier.**

Play Ruffnauts: New Frontiers today! Save all the pets in the galaxy from the evil Catos!

Join our Discord for updates, sneak peeks, and a your own crew:
discord.gg/ruffnautsvr
